questions.q: What does the Transactions Available for Reconciliation report show?
options: A history of every bank's annual fees
Open system transactions that are eligible to be matched but haven't been yet
Only transactions that have already reconciled
The company's full chart of accounts
questions.explain: This report shows the 'what's still waiting' view from the system side — open transactions not yet matched to a statement.

questions.q: Which report would a Cash Manager use to see, line by line, which statement lines reconciled and which didn't for one specific statement?
options: Cash to General Ledger Reconciliation report
Transactions Available for Reconciliation report
Cash Forecasting report
Bank Statement reconciliation report (detail)
questions.explain: The Bank Statement reconciliation report is the primary working report for reviewing a specific statement's matched and unreconciled lines.

questions.q: What does the Cash to General Ledger Reconciliation report compare?
options: The reconciled cash balance in Cash Management against the GL cash account balance
Two different bank accounts' balances
This year's cash forecast against last year's
Bank statement formats against each other
questions.explain: This report compares what's reconciled in Cash Management to what the General Ledger's cash account actually shows.

questions.q: Does a difference on the Cash to General Ledger Reconciliation report always indicate an error?
options: Yes, it always means a transaction was recorded incorrectly
No, differences on this report can always be ignored
No — it might simply mean reconciled transactions haven't been through Create Accounting yet, but it must still be explained
Yes, but only if the bank statement format is CAMT.053
questions.explain: A difference isn't automatically an error — it could reflect a pending accounting run — but it must be explained before month-end close.

questions.q: In the worked example, what explained Harborview Metals Inc.'s $4,200 difference?
options: A duplicate bank statement load
Already-reconciled transactions that hadn't yet run through that day's Create Accounting process
An unmapped transaction code
A bank error requiring escalation
questions.explain: Both other reports showed everything accounted for on the system and statement side, pointing to a pending Create Accounting run as the explanation.
